motion_rule: she cannot move, so everything moves at her. Her tray is shoved along the counter in most beats, the ice sliding under her. Every beat one thing crosses the lens a shoulder away: a hand, a crate, a cap, ice. Nothing far or in the background; camera tracks sideways at ice level, never wider than the seller waist-up, new shot size each beat
character: a plump mackerel, mirror-striped flank, on crushed ice, gills and jaw working
second_characters: ONE heavy seller, white cap, apron, gold teeth, hands and belly sweeping the lens every beat; ONE buyer, arms and trolley only
props: ONE card reading 3999 on a spike; A SWARM of half-rotten salmon heads; ONE bag; ONE fish bone
prop_continuity: the 3999 spike stands in her ice from 1.25 and travels with the tray
environment: a fish market row, counters and crates a fin away both sides
light_events: flat white noon, a mirror flash down her flank at 3.65-4.25

audio.language: Russian, lines verbatim; latin hints never spoken
audio.delivery: smug female mackerel voice, biting each word off, 4 syllables per second
audio.pronunciation: prosh-LI, vre-me-NA, lo-SO-sya, te-PER, ma-YA, O-che-red, blis-TAT, BU-desh, KAZH-doy, KOS-toch-ke
audio.pacing: 0.00-1.95, 1.95-4.25 and 4.25-6.65 each one breath, no gaps; after 6.65 not a word, sfx only
audio.lip_sync: her jaw opens on every syllable
audio.sfx: ice crunching, trays scraping, fish slapping, his guffaw, market din

timeline.a: her tail whips A SWARM of salmon heads across the lens as his hand shoves her tray down the counter
a scoop of ice dumps over her flank at the lens, the tray still travelling
his fist rams the 3999 spike into the ice a fin away, chips at the lens, the tray jolting to a stop
his forearm sweeps the whole lens clearing the counter, her tray shunted on again
a crate slams down beside her and the ice jumps her half a body sideways
his cap cuts across the lens dragging a wet rag, spray at the glass, her tray shoved again
he tips a bucket, ice avalanches past the lens, glare running down her flank
the buyer's hand rips a fish out of the next heap and it slumps at the lens
his belly passes a hand from the lens, the scale hook swinging after it
a second tray shoves in beside hers, ice spilling across the frame
an empty bag balloons open at the lens in his fist
he snaps the bag taut, her tray tips and slides her to its edge
the bag pops and his hand rakes her off the ice into it, tail sticking out
the bag slams on the scales at the lens, needle punching over, ice bouncing
bag to the buyer, notes into his paw and under his coat; his free hand rips a bone out of a crate
his face fills the lens, he guffaws and picks his teeth with that bone, grinning mean, her head low in the bag
he keeps picking, the bag swinging as the trolley hauls away across the lens
his hand shoves the emptied tray down the counter, ice scattering at the lens

must_appear: her tray is shoved along the counter in most beats; something crosses the lens a shoulder away every beat; last word by 6.65; the punch is the seller's: his bone, his teeth, his grin, face to the lens, no backs after 8.35
negative_prompt: subtitles, watermark, letterbox, a wide shot, a parked camera, a standing seller, standing bystanders, slow motion, a foreign accent, a word not in the lines, cyrillic letters, duplicate props, cuts
